newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PROMOTED EMPOLI CONFIRM COACH SPALLETTI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PROMOTED EMPOLI CONFIRM COACH SPALLETTI.

text.p: Newly-promoted Italian soccer club Empoli said on Wednesday that Luciano Spalletti would remain their coach in serie A next season.

The 38-year-old Spalletti, who took the provincial club from serie C to serie B at the start of last season, had told a news conference earlier in the week that he was not sure whether he was ready for serie A and wanted time to think.
"The A frightens me a bit," he had told reporters in remarks that caught the club by surprise.
On Wednesday he said he had decided to stay.
"There was no particular reason to convince me to stay," he said. "I made the choice and now I hope the club can manage to put together a group good enough to stay up."
Empoli, near Florence, were briefly in serie A from 1986 to 1988. They were docked five points in 1987-88 for alleged match rigging in the 1985-86 season and relegated.
